newsitem.title: CHINA: China inflation to ease further in late '96 - paper.
newsitem.headline: China inflation to ease further in late '96 - paper.

text.p: China's inflation was expected to continue easing to reach a year-on-year 4.6 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996, the China Business Daily said on Wednesday.
Retail price inflation had been held to a year-on-year 6.6 percent in the first three quarters, according to previously announced official data.
Retail price inflation stood at 14.8 percent last year after reaching 21.7 percent in 1994.
The newspaper also estimated that inflation would be 4.8 percent in October, 4.7 percent in November and 4.5 percent in December this year. It did not give a source for its forecast.
Central bank governor Dai Xianglong has said he expeced inflation would be below 6.6 percent for all of 1996.
